findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 logic and placeholder queries in research commands and quality forecasting

evidence.observation: TODO comment indicates quality_anomalies query is unimplemented
Multiple TODO comments for Phase 5 implementation covering authorization checking via Supabase and decision_to_memory integration

proposed_action.description: Complete Phase 5 implementations for authorization and memory integration, and implement the quality_anomalies table query.

findings.expected_benefit: Eliminates placeholder stubs and enables full authorization, memory integration, and anomaly tracking functionality.

findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: call_log_exists is false and call_log_size_mb is null for configured path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router creates and logs routing calls to the configured call_log.jsonl file.

findings.expected_benefit: Enables auditing, performance monitoring, and usage tracking for all model routing operations.

findings.title: Direct LLM provider API calls bypassing model router in emergency alert summary

evidence.observation: Direct invocation of call_gemini using GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable bypassing router
Direct invocation of call_mistral using MISTRAL_API_KEY environment variable bypassing router

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM invocations through the central model router endpoint instead of invoking client libraries directly.

findings.expected_benefit: Centralises telemetry, failure handling, model fallbacks, and rate limit management.
